register.title: IP register
register.description: Intellectual property of the organisation: requests, filings with MOET, registrations and renewals.
register.search: Search by number, name or document
register.emptyHint: Records appear here once an IP request is submitted or a flagged document is published.

record.rejectedByMoet: MOET rejected the application. File it again or close the record.
record.expired: The protection has expired. Record a renewal to restore it.
record.nextFile: Next step: file the application with MOET (or register internally for internal-only protection).
record.nextRegister: Next step: record the registration once MOET issues the certificate.
record.moetFormReady: The MOET registration form is filled in automatically and can be downloaded from the actions above.
record.moetFormAdminsOnly: The MOET registration form contains Emirates IDs, so only IP administrators can download it.
record.documentsHint: Upload the registration certificate and supporting files here; the registration and renewal dialogs let you pick the certificate from these files.

dialogs.filingDescription: Enter the filing date and the application number MOET gave.
dialogs.internalDescription: This protection type is internal only: the record receives an internal registration number today.
dialogs.registrationDescription: The expiry date is proposed from the protection term; change it if the certificate says otherwise. Every employee contributor receives the certificate notice.
dialogs.moetRejectionDescription: Record why MOET rejected the application. The office can then file again or close the record.
dialogs.closeDescription: The record is closed after the MOET rejection and cannot be filed again.
dialogs.renewDescription: Enter the new protection period and its registration number.
dialogs.notInFuture: The filing date cannot be in the future.
dialogs.certificateHint: One of the files uploaded on the Documents tab.
dialogs.noExpiryHint: This protection type has no expiry; leave empty.
dialogs.publicationHint: The copyright term counts from the first publication of the work.

contributors.editDescription: Each contributor is an employee or an external person. Shares must total 100 %. Leave the masked Emirates ID as it is to keep the stored one.
contributors.name: Name
contributors.revealHint_one: A revealed Emirates ID is shown for {{count}} second and every reveal is audited.
contributors.revealHint_other: A revealed Emirates ID is shown for {{count}} seconds and every reveal is audited.
contributors.maskHint: Masked: the stored Emirates ID is kept unless you type a new one.

moet.title: Description of the work for MOET

similar.title: Similar records
similar.none: No similar IP records or documents found.

dashboard.title: IP dashboard
dashboard.description: Registered and pending intellectual property, by type, protection, year and unit, with upcoming expiries.

settings.title: Intellectual property
settings.description: Protection terms, internal-only protection types, renewal reminders and the header of the MOET registration form.
settings.protectionsHint: The term proposes the expiry date at registration. Internal-only types are registered internally instead of filed with MOET.
settings.remindersHint: The IP office and the owner unit head are reminded this many months before the expiry date.

errors.term: The term must be between 1 and 100 years, or no expiry.
errors.duplicate: Each protection type can have only one rule.
errors.reminderMonths: Up to 5 reminders, each between 1 and 60 months before expiry.
errors.contributorWho: Choose an employee or enter the external person's name.
errors.notAllowed: This action is not possible in the record's current status.
errors.expiryBeforeRegistration: The expiry date must be after the registration date.
errors.file: Choose one of this record's files as the certificate.
errors.period: Enter the registration number and a period whose end is after its start.
errors.publicationDate: The first publication cannot be after the registration date or in the future.
errors.publicationRequired: Give the first publication date (the term counts from it) or an expiry date.
